evidence: src/kernel/chainparams.cpp defines consensus rules, PoW limits, difficulty adjustments, and BIP 54 activation from block 1.
rationale: Defines consensus parameters for BIP 95 / Testnet 5 to eliminate block storms and test BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis. As the description notes, 'Relative to Testnet 4 it removes the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception, raises the minimum difficulty, and enforces BIP 54 from block 1.'
